description: Check, set or clear the app's public slug (the readable name in play.neblla.com/<slug or id>). `checkOnly: true` only tells whether it is valid and free; when another app of YOURS holds it (its slug or an old one) it says so (`reason: "yours"`, `heldBy`). `slug: null` removes it. An old slug keeps leading to the app (it stays the app's; nobody else can take it), and the users' sessions follow. `move: true` takes a slug from another app of yours (e.g. moving a game to a new app): the other app loses it and its address leads to this one from then on. At least 5 characters. Changing it changes the public URL — confirm with the developer.

move.description: Take it from another app of yours that holds it (its slug or an old one)

slug.description: Wanted slug (lowercase letters, digits, dashes), or null to clear

name: neblla_set_slug
